gtransline.py.summary: Translate the non-English (mostly Chinese) lines of files in place.
details: Detects the lines containing CJK or other non-ASCII text, translates them with googletrans or deep_translator (whichever is installed), rewrites the files and processes them in a worker pool with a progress report.

gzbz.py.summary: Compress or decompress the files of a tree with bzip2 or gzip.
details: Subcommands: ``bz2`` handles the bzip2 files, ``gz`` the gzip and tar files and ``gzip-files`` recompresses the plain files recursively (skipping the already compressed extensions and the small files); ``-l`` sets the level and the chunks are streamed in 512 KB blocks.

hasdoc.py.summary: Check the Python files for comments and docstrings that were not stripped.
details: Parses each file, counts the remaining comment lines and docstrings and reports the files that still have them, working through a directory in a pool.

Turns a digest into a memorable word phrase and back (``--humanize``, ``--dehumanize``), generates the human-readable UUIDs (v3, v4, v5), verifies a phrase against a hex digest, reports the entropy bits for a word count and hashes text with the chosen algorithm.
hhash.py.usage: hhash [--uuid|--humanize HEX|--verify HEX PHRASE|--hash TEXT] [--algorithm sha256]

html2markdown.py.summary: Convert HTML files to Markdown or plain text.
details: Subcommands: ``to-md`` converts with an external ``htm2md``, ``html_to_markdown``, pandoc or ``readability`` and can remove the originals, ``to-text`` strips the tags with the stdlib parser and ``fetch`` downloads a URL as text (optionally rendering the JS with pyppeteer and taking a screenshot).

html_tag_balancer.py.summary: Check and fix the tag balance of HTML files.
details: Walks the markup with the stdlib parser, reports the missing, unclosed and unexpected closing tags and with ``-a`` appends the missing ones and removes the stray ones in place.

htmlcleaner.py.summary: Extract the inline CSS and JavaScript of HTML files into ``assets``.
details: Finds the ``<style>`` and ``<script>`` blocks, writes them into ``assets/css``/``assets/js`` under content-hashed names, links them back from the page and processes the tree in parallel (``--min-size`` sets the extraction threshold).

htmlformat.py.summary: Reformat HTML files so every tag starts on its own line.
details: Parses the document with tree-sitter HTML, re-emits the nodes one per line while keeping the text content, writes the files atomically (with a dry-run and a 50 MB size cap) and works through the tree in parallel.

htmlstrip.py.summary: Remove the tags or the meta tags of HTML files.
details: Subcommands: ``tag`` deletes a named element with BeautifulSoup, ``meta`` removes the ``<meta ...>`` tags with a regex (``--pattern`` overrides it) and ``all`` strips every tag of one file; ``-w`` writes in place, the default is a dry run and the marker lines (``<:``/``>:``) are preserved.

hunspeller.py.summary: Detect and optionally fix the misspelled words of a text file with Hunspell.
details: Checks each line against the Hunspell dictionary (``-d``/``--affix``, or the ones it discovers with ``--list-dicts``) in a process pool, prints the unknown words and with ``-a`` replaces them with the first suggestion.

image_remover.py.summary: Remove the images from documentation files.
details: Subcommands: ``fast`` deletes the Markdown/HTML images, ``smart`` the badges and remote images, ``markdown`` only the Markdown ones, ``remote`` the ``http(s)`` references and ``html`` uses BeautifulSoup; the RST ``image::`` directives and the badge domains are recognised.

Subcommands: ``to-jpg``/``to-png`` convert (Pillow, OpenCV, pillow-heif or ImageMagick), ``gif-to-jpg`` extracts the frames, ``invert`` negates the colours in place and ``html-to-png`` renders a file, a directory or an inline HTML string through WeasyPrint/pdf2image; ``--quality``, ``--overwrite`` and ``--delete-source`` control the output.

img_similarity.py.summary: Find, group and deduplicate similar images.
details: Hashes the images (perceptual phash/dhash/ahash/whash, colour hash, DCT, HSV histograms or a multi-hash mix), groups the ones under the distance threshold and the ``scan``/``organize``/``dedup``/``keep-one``/``cluster`` subcommands report, move, delete or cluster them.

imgco.py.summary: Convert images to a target format.
details: Chooses the backend (OpenCV, scikit-image, Pillow or ImageMagick), converts each image to ``--to`` (jpg by default) at the given quality, keeps or replaces the sources (``-k``/``-f``) and runs the conversion in parallel with ``--dry-run``/``--list-targets`` support.

imgdownloader.py.summary: Search Google Images and download the results.
details: Builds the image-search URL from the query and the extra filters (exact/optional/excluded words, size, colour, type), scrapes the result links with Selenium and downloads them in parallel with requests, httpx or pycurl.
imgdownloader.py.usage: imgdownloader -q QUERY [-l LIMIT] [-o DIR] [--size large] [--type photo]

details: Subcommands: ``auto-enhance``/``pil-enhance`` improve the photos in place, ``downscale``/``resize`` shrink them by a factor, ``upscale`` enlarges the small ones, ``strip-exif`` removes the metadata, ``optimize-png`` calls optipng/oxipng and ``embed-optimize`` compresses the base64 assets inside CSS/HTML/JS.
